#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Blog post creation utility. The `create_blog_post` function sanitises user‑supplied heading and text, inserts them into a pre‑defined HTML skeleton, and returns the result ready for safe rendering on a web page. Author: ChatGPT """ import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced by # the escaped heading and text respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Raises ------ TypeError If either `heading` or `text` is not a string. ValueError If either `heading` or `text` is an empty string after stripping. """ # Basic type checks if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError("`heading` must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("`text` must be a string") # Strip leading/trailing whitespace heading_clean = heading.strip() text_clean = text.strip() # Ensure non‑empty content if not heading_clean: raise ValueError("`heading` cannot be empty") if not text_clean: raise ValueError("`text` cannot be empty") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS heading_escaped = html.escape(heading_clean, quote=True) text_escaped = html.escape(text_clean, quote=True) # Convert newlines to
tags for basic formatting text_escaped = text_escaped.replace("\n", "
\n") # Insert into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=heading_escaped, body=text_escaped) return formatted_post
